title: The Lighthouse Keeper
logline: An ageing keeper turns a lighthouse lens by hand through a blackout storm so that eleven men she will never meet can find harbour.

style_bible.art_style: Soft gouache storybook illustration with visible brush texture and simplified, graphic shapes
style_bible.lighting: A single warm light source against cold ambient blue
style_bible.camera_language: Patient, mostly locked-off framing; movement only when the story turns
style_bible.line_and_texture: Soft edges, dry-brush grain, no fine linework
style_bible.motion_language: Gentle, unhurried camera movement; nothing whips or snaps

characters.name: Mara Halloran
characters.skin: weathered and wind-reddened, freckled across the nose
characters.default_wardrobe: a heavy oilskin coat over a fisherman's jumper, fingerless wool gloves

locations.name: The lamp room
locations.description: The glass chamber at the top of the tower housing the lens
locations.prompt_fragment: a cramped glass lamp room, brass fittings, a huge faceted lens, storm-black windows

locations.name: The tower stair
locations.description: A tight spiral of 211 stone steps
locations.prompt_fragment: a narrow spiral stone staircase, worn treads, deep shadow

locations.name: The keeper's kitchen
locations.description: A small room with one electric bulb and a ledger on the table
locations.prompt_fragment: a small spare kitchen, scrubbed table, an open ledger

locations.name: The sea off Corrow Point
locations.description: Open water, changing with the season
locations.prompt_fragment: open grey-green sea under a low sky, no land in sight

shots.action: The lighthouse stands alone on a black rock as dusk falls over open water
shots.subject_motion: The beam sweeps once across the water; waves move slowly below

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: For forty-one winters, Mara kept the light burning.

shots.action: Mara sits alone at a scrubbed table writing in a ledger by one dim bulb
shots.subject_motion: Her hand moves steadily across the page; the bulb flickers faintly

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Nobody had ever asked her to.

scenes.title: The moods of the sea
scenes.summary: She knows the water like a language

shots.action: Flat grey water stretching to a pale horizon under high cloud
shots.subject_motion: Light moves slowly across the surface of the water

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: She learned the sea the way others learn a language.

shots.action: Black water hammering against rock under a starless sky
shots.subject_motion: Spray bursts upward and falls; the water heaves

shots.action: A close view of a ledger page filled with tiny handwriting and weather notes
shots.subject_motion: The page edge lifts slightly in a draught

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: She wrote the weather in a ledger nobody read.

shots.action: Mara sits in total darkness, the bulb above her dead
shots.subject_motion: Nothing moves but her breath; darkness settles

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: In her seventy-third winter, the island went dark.

shots.action: Mara's face in near darkness, turned toward the sound of the storm
shots.subject_motion: Her eyes shift slightly; her jaw tightens

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Out there, the ships could not see her.

shots.action: Mara climbs a narrow spiral stair carrying an oil can and matches
shots.subject_motion: She climbs steadily upward, one hand on the wall

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: So she climbed. Two hundred and eleven steps.

scenes.title: Lit by hand
scenes.summary: The old lamp, the old way

shots.action: Mara touches a lit match to the wick of a large brass oil lamp
shots.subject_motion: The flame catches and grows; warm light spreads across brass

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: She lit it by hand, as the first keeper had.

shots.action: Mara leans into a handle, turning the great lens by her own strength
shots.subject_motion: The lens rotates slowly; her shoulders work against the weight

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: The clockwork needed power she did not have.

scenes.title: Four in the morning
scenes.summary: Past the end of her strength

shots.action: Mara's stiff hands gripping the handle, knuckles white
shots.subject_motion: Her fingers tremble but do not release

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: Her shoulders gave out. She kept turning.

shots.action: A trawler moves through grey dawn water toward a harbour mouth
shots.subject_motion: The boat moves steadily forward through low swell

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: At seven, eleven men made harbour.

shots.action: Mara sits upright, looking directly ahead, unimpressed

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: It was not brave, she said. Bravery is decided.

shots.action: The lighthouse small against a wide darkening sea, its beam turning
shots.subject_motion: The beam completes one slow sweep across the water

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text: She had never considered letting it go out.
